inputs.question: Are water and wastewater pipe sizes and materials labeled on the utility plan? Are pipe locations shown relative to property boundaries? Are any pipes 24 inches or larger shown, and if so, are they depicted as double lines?
inputs.regionHint: overall utility plan drawing showing proposed infrastructure
inputs.reasoning: The agent is asking whether pipe annotations (size, material labels), spatial relationships (location relative to property boundaries), and line-style conventions (double-line representation for large pipes) are present and correctly depicted on the drawing itself—all drawing-element inspection tasks, not measurements.

applicableChecklistItems.checklist_deficiency_text: Size, pipe material, or location of W/WW/reclaimed mains not shown with respect to easements/ROW, or pipes >=24 inches not shown as double lines

result.answerText: Water and wastewater pipe sizes and materials are labeled, such as a 12" DI Water Main and an 8" PVC Fire Line. Pipe locations are shown spatially relative to the property boundaries on the plan. There are existing pipes 24 inches or larger (e.g., a 48" water line and a 54" storm drain), but they are depicted as single lines, not double lines.
